pairs.why: The two armchairs are nearly identical; B's velvet reads a touch smoother and less fuzzy, which matches the lessons' preference for smoother surfaces.
Almost a duplicate pair; A's upholstery shows slightly less fuzzy velvet grain on the wings and seat, so it is a bit closer to the smooth real cards.
Shape, colour, light and finish are the same in both chairs, with no visible difference in smoothness or build.
B's red is a little richer, with softer, more even shading like the boxing gloves, but the difference is very small.
A frames the door with dense, lush flowering vines and a pot, like the ivy-framed real door card, while B looks sparse and empty.
B has the fuller flowering vine and potted plant that match the lush framing of the real cards, while A's corner greenery is thin.
Both are dense and rendered the same way; B's flowers in both top corners frame the door a little more fully, like the real ivy door.
Both are near-identical; A's foliage frames the scene on both sides and in both top corners, a bit closer to the real door card's composition.
